summary: Push day. Lunch brings in Chicken Vindaloo for protein-source variety (new main, no repeats from the last few days), dinner is Mary's Kung Pao Chicken (dialed back to 0.75 serving to manage fat) with extra chicken breast and rice. Pre-workout uses today's wellness-bar Strawberry Mango Tajin Smoothie (has added protein powder) since no cottage cheese flavor is on the menu.

meals.name: Uber HQ Lunch
